name: com.parlortable/parlor-table
title: Parlor Table
description: Classic table games (cards, board, dice) with rules, played free in the browser, and daily puzzles.

tools.name: find_game
tools.description: Find one of Parlor Table's 75 free classic games (Cribbage, Canasta, Euchre, Spades, Hearts, Gin Rummy, Bridge, Mahjong, Backgammon, Dominoes, Five Dice, solitaires, Bingo, Trivia and more) by name, kind or number of players. Returns the start of the rules in plain English and a link to play right away in the browser against the computer or with family over a link, no sign-up. Made for adults; no money or betting.

query.description: Game name, kind or players, e.g. "cribbage", "card games for 2", "dice", "solitaire"

tools.name: daily_puzzles
tools.description: Parlor Table's daily puzzles and deals, the same for everyone each day with a streak: word search, sudoku, cryptogram, mini crossword, nonograms and a daily deal for many card games; also printable score sheets and a bingo card generator. Use when someone wants a daily puzzle, a brain game for seniors or something printable.
